clue.text: By NIL. sIMILE out of PIANISSIMO. Has the largest feet ever, plus a tight lip and an ill temper.
By GENTLEMAN JOCKEY out of RHODA FLEMING. It gets worse, her catarrh does; I'd shoot her pronto.
By THE BEAK out of ADULATION You need your spurs or your whip to budge him at all
By RAY'S A LAUGH out of CAN'T SEE ME. Is prone to be tired out travelling to the starting post.
By NUNC DIMITTIS out of TONGUE TWISTER. If dis- gruntled punters utter a 'Bah', like a sheep, I'll echo it.
By BARITONE out of RANGEFINDER. Has helped the Land Army too often to have any verve remaining.
By ONE ROUND out of COME BY CHANCE. Does Well in every bally test run, but crumples in the real event.
By SHAM AMATEUR out of ALWAYS VIENNA A high stepper; might trip on as a Russian ballerina.
By LEATHERWARE out of SUMMER SUNSHINE. Are there always good excuses for his flops? Yes, always.
By BALLPLAYER out of coROzo. Has been apt to vary, scoring anything from eighth to fourteenth.
By WHITEHEADED BOY out of CUSHENDALL. Though he has the courage of a lion, his brains and speed are nil
By BEDRIDDEN out of GRISELDA. The sort of horse I would extirpate, even at my own expense.
